name: Latin letter glyph identity
predicate: The visible foreground belongs to a member of the fixed Latin-letter codebook.

name: Ordered string identity
predicate: The characters at each position and their order match the target token string.

name: Digit string identity
predicate: The visible digits at successive positions form the fixed short string.

name: Punctuation token sequence
predicate: Punctuation types, counts and positions between characters match the target.

name: Icon codebook membership
predicate: The complete icon belongs to a member of the fixed icon codebook.

name: Arrowhead and tail identity
predicate: The arrow has the specified head type, tail type and symbolic direction.

name: Symbol foreground and negative-space polarity
predicate: The strokes of the specified symbol are realized by foreground or negative space as required; this concerns the realization of symbolic identity only.

name: Multiple-reading symbol identity
predicate: The same symbol decodes to the specified pair of tokens under the declared reading orientations.

name: Musical note symbol identity
predicate: The notehead, stem and other components form the fixed musical note symbol.

name: Three-arrow recycling symbol identity
predicate: Three arrow components jointly form the fixed recycling symbol.

name: Emblem and logo codebook membership
predicate: The complete component combination belongs to the fixed emblem or logo codebook.

name: Discrete color codebook identity
predicate: Identity-bearing colors match the specified discrete codebook members.

name: Shape-sequence codebook identity
predicate: The ordered group of shapes, considered as a whole, matches the specified symbol codebook.

name: Color-band and topmark codebook identity
predicate: The color bands and topmark jointly match the specified composite symbol.

name: Component-based status badge identity
predicate: The specified components jointly form the declared status badge.

name: Framed-mark codebook identity
predicate: The frame and its internal marks jointly match the specified composite symbol.

name: Circular stamp and cancellation-line identity
predicate: The circular stamp and registered line group jointly form the specified composite mark.

name: Open orthogonal path direction sequence
predicate: The sequence of horizontal and vertical segment directions along the open path matches the target.

name: Orthogonal boundary turns and length order
predicate: Turns and relative lengths along the complete boundary match the specified geometric identity.

name: Open curved path contour
predicate: The bending directions, control points and local curvature of a single open curve match the target.

name: Overall contour class
predicate: The complete outer contour belongs to the fixed shape class.

name: Reflected contour correspondence
predicate: The two actual contours are reflections of each other across the specified axis.

name: Half-turn contour correspondence
predicate: The two actual foreground masks coincide after a 180-degree rotation.

name: Object orientation identity
predicate: The object's principal axis or directional component points in the specified direction.

name: Relative length order
predicate: The visible lengths of the specified objects strictly follow the fixed order.

name: Relative width order
predicate: The visible widths of the specified objects follow the fixed order.

name: Visible height order
predicate: Visible heights measured along a common axis follow the specified order.

name: Aspect ratio identity
predicate: The dimensionless width-to-height ratio in the specified measurement plane lies within the fixed interval.

name: Four-corner radius vector
predicate: The ordered radii of the four rounded corners match the fixed vector.

name: Regular star vertices and phase
predicate: The closed star has the target numbers of outer points and inner valleys and the specified phase.

name: Polygonal hole-boundary contour
predicate: The number of sides, phase and contour of the located hole boundary satisfy the specified geometry.

name: Liquid-level and graduation alignment
predicate: The actual liquid-level feature point aligns with the specified graduation along the same measurement axis.

name: Pointer and graduation angular alignment
predicate: The actual pointer tip aligns with the ray of the specified graduation.

name: Shared-boundary geometry
predicate: The shape and turns of the actual shared boundary satisfy the geometric requirements.

name: Overlap-region geometry
predicate: The contour and geometric position of the actual foreground intersection satisfy the requirements.

name: Curvature event sequence
predicate: The sequence of straight segments, left bends, right bends or curvature extrema along the directed contour matches the target.

name: Multilayer pose registration
predicate: The relative translations, rotations and alignments of the actual layers satisfy the geometric requirements.

name: Projected path-crossing geometry
predicate: The crossing positions and geometric relationships of visible paths in image projection satisfy the requirements.

name: Visible contour after occlusion
predicate: Only the boundaries, directions and contours of actually visible foreground fragments are compared.

name: Common baseline and relative alignment
predicate: Actual feature points or edges satisfy the specified equal-height, collinearity or offset relationships in the declared measurement space.

name: Rigid rotation correspondence
predicate: wo actual contours or layouts have corresponding geometry under the specified rotation angle.

name: Connected-component count identity
predicate: The number of connected components in the evaluated foreground matches the target.

name: Enclosed-hole structure
predicate: The number and ownership of enclosed background components within the foreground match the target.

name: Visible connection graph
predicate: Nodes and physical connections form the fixed directed or undirected graph.

name: Endpoint pairing graph
predicate: Each visible endpoint is connected to exactly its target partner.

name: Free-end inventory
predicate: The number of free ends of the path or network and their branch memberships match the target.

name: Branching and merging structure
predicate: Paths branch or merge as specified at the fixed locations.

name: Open and closed path identity
predicate: Path components are open chains or closed loops with the specified counts.

name: Actual path self-connection structure
predicate: Actual self-connections of the path form the specified nodes and branches.

name: Physical crossing over-under signature
predicate: The identity-bearing over-under relationships are preserved at corresponding crossings of the specified physical paths.

name: Closed-boundary nesting structure
predicate: Closed regions form the target nesting tree under deformations that do not cross the specified boundaries.

name: Region adjacency graph
predicate: Actual shared-wall adjacency between regions matches the target.

name: Boundary contact relationship
predicate: The specified entities or regions actually touch, or do not touch, the target boundary as required.

name: Path-segment continuity
predicate: All registered segments connect into the target number of continuous path components.

name: Port-to-terminal connectivity
predicate: Each source port reaches its unique target terminal through one complete path.

name: Physical chain interlocking
predicate: Adjacent rings, clasps or chain segments interlock in the specified manner.

name: Shared-boundary topology
predicate: wo regions share, or do not share, a boundary segment of nonzero length as specified.

name: Physical partition component structure
predicate: Partition walls divide the working surface into region components with the specified count and adjacency.

name: Node-degree multiset
predicate: The degrees of all actual connection nodes form the target multiset.

name: Linear instance order
predicate: The sequence of instance categories along the fixed axis matches the target.

name: Anchored circular order
predicate: The circular sequence read from the unique physical anchor in the specified direction matches the target.

name: Two-dimensional slot occupancy
predicate: The occupancy state of each slot in the finite grid matches the target.

name: Row and column membership
predicate: Each instance belongs to the target row, column or row-column intersection.

name: Object-to-region assignment
predicate: Components with distinct identities are placed in the specified spatial regions.

name: Object-to-slot assignment
predicate: Typed objects occupy the target physical slots with no additional instances.

name: One-to-one instance pairing
predicate: Two sets of instances form the fixed one-to-one correspondence.

name: Internal spatial roles of functional parts
predicate: Visible components of the whole occupy their specified internal spatial roles and positions.

name: Group membership assignment
predicate: Each node or object belongs only to its target group.

name: Physical occlusion layer order
predicate: The front-to-back ordering of visible entities satisfies the specified relationships.

name: Cross-view component layout consistency
predicate: The spatial roles of components maintain the specified correspondence across multiple visible faces or views of the same whole.

name: Color-to-position assignment
predicate: Fixed color tokens are assigned to the target regions, circular positions or objects.

name: Attributed-object spatial assignment
predicate: Objects with distinguishable identity attributes are assigned to specified spatial positions or regions.

name: Depth-slot assignment across physical frames
predicate: Objects belong to the target layers, frames, boxes or front-to-back depth slots.

name: Support-surface and mounting-side assignment
predicate: Specified parts are carried by the specified visible support surfaces or mounted on the specified sides.

name: Neighboring-instance relationship
predicate: Specified objects are adjacent or separated as required along an ordered axis or within a physical layout.

name: Valid component tiling
predicate: A finite set of parts with given shapes forms the specified valid tiling within the whole.

name: Object-to-container assignment
predicate: Objects with distinct identities belong to the specified visible container instances.

name: Layout preservation across stages
predicate: Component positions explicitly required to remain fixed share the same layout across the visible stages.

name: Local-part position within a whole
predicate: An identity-bearing local component occupies the specified region or relative position within the whole.

name: Spatial channel assignment
predicate: Visible objects or event markers occupy the specified spatial channels.

name: Spatial order of oriented units
predicate: Repeated units with directional labels form the specified spatial sequence within the whole.

name: Total instance count
predicate: The total number of visible instances within the specified scope matches the target.

name: Regional count vector
predicate: Instance counts in ordered regions form the target vector.

name: Contiguous unit-segment count vector
predicate: Counts of contiguous complete discrete units in the specified segments form the target vector.

name: Calibrated numeric-window value
predicate: The visible numeric window represents the target numerical value under the specified calibration.

name: Two-pointer periodic scalar reading
predicate: Two pointers with explicit roles jointly map to the target scalar on a periodic scale.

name: Single-pointer angular scalar reading
predicate: The pointer tip maps to the target scalar on the calibrated angular scale.

name: Linear-scale position reading
predicate: The visible state boundary maps to the target scalar on the calibrated linear scale.

name: Whole-and-partial icon quantity
predicate: The number of whole icons and the single partial icon jointly represent the target fractional quantity.

name: Calibrated field-state value vector
predicate: States of multiple visible fields map to the target numerical vector under an explicit calibration.

name: Modular height vector
predicate: Unit-block counts in ordered modular towers form the target height vector.

name: Ordered aggregate magnitude vector
predicate: Counts or calibrated quantities along the specified statistical index form the target magnitude vector.

name: Two-dimensional regional count matrix
predicate: Instance counts in two-dimensionally ordered regions form the target count matrix.

name: Radial sector count vector
predicate: Instance counts in radial sectors, starting from the unique angular anchor, form the target vector.

name: Cumulative nested-region counts
predicate: Cumulative instance counts across nested regions from inside to outside form the target monotonic vector.

name: Spatial density gradient
predicate: Instance densities in equal-area or calibrated regions increase, decrease or form extrema in the specified direction.

name: Regional area-coverage ratio vector
predicate: Fractions of each ordered region covered by the target foreground form the target vector.

name: Regional count-difference vector
predicate: Instance-count differences between specified region pairs form the target signed vector.

name: Group-size ordering
predicate: Instance counts of visible groups satisfy the target total or partial order.

name: Spatial count-balance relationship
predicate: Counts in mirrored, opposed or paired regions satisfy equality, a difference of one or the specified balance relationship.

name: Visible stroke-addition chain
predicate: Specified strokes are added at successive visible stages while existing strokes are preserved.

name: Visible state-transition chain
predicate: Adjacent visible states are connected by permitted local operations in the target order.

name: Anchored cyclic state process
predicate: Read from the unique keyed position in the specified direction, states strictly expand, reach an extremum, retract and close the cycle.

name: Visible motion-frame sequence
predicate: All visible frames express the target motion stages and trend in index order.

name: Directed feed event sequence
predicate: Event order and transitions are read along visible physical feed or stage anchors.

name: Visible material-layer addition record
predicate: Visible stages or an explicit formation axis record the addition and retention of material or layers.

name: Progressive regional revision
predicate: Successive visible impressions add or remove one registered region per step and converge.

name: Anchored state-transition front
predicate: Visible direction or stage evidence constrains a source state to become the target state through a transition front.

name: Valid folding transition
predicate: Each adjacent paper-box state can be obtained by one permitted folding operation.

name: Indexed local replacement
predicate: Each step in the ordered states replaces exactly one registered unit and preserves all other units.

name: Cumulative deletion
predicate: Each step removes only permitted existing components while preserving the remaining components.

name: Monotonic state growth
predicate: The target state never decreases along the stage axis and increases at least once.

name: Monotonic state decay
predicate: The target state never increases along the stage axis and decreases at least once.

name: Single-peak expansion and contraction
predicate: The state strictly increases to a unique extremum and then strictly decreases.

name: Alternating state process
predicate: Two or more discrete states alternate along the stage axis according to the fixed pattern.

name: Visible trigger propagation
predicate: Visible shared stages and trigger anchors constrain states to propagate sequentially through the given network.

name: Visible synchronous multi-unit transition
predicate: Multiple units undergo the specified synchronous changes at common visible stage boundaries.

name: Ordered multi-unit updates
predicate: Multiple registered units perform local transformations in the specified role order.

name: Visually time-anchored trajectory
predicate: Multiple visible temporal samples of the same object form a trajectory in the anchored direction.

name: Event-conditioned deformation sequence
predicate: The object undergoes a visible discrete deformation at the specified event stage and then recovers or enters the next state.
